slides.headline: Someone did something. You are still carrying it.
body: Dr Titi Sodipo has a habit for this. She has used it for years.
When she thinks someone has hurt her, she stops.
And then she starts making excuses for them.
Maybe they forgot. Maybe something happened at home. Maybe.

slides.headline: Maybe is the whole thing.
body: She is not deciding that they are innocent.
She is refusing to decide that they are guilty.
It stops her being angry for no reason.
It was never really about them. It is about what she has to carry around.
slides.kicker: Her words: let me make maybe.

scripture.text: Make allowance for each other's faults, and forgive anyone who offends you.

slides.headline: Try it this week.
body: One person. The one you are still annoyed with.
slides.kicker: You do not have to tell them. That is not the point.
